PLAN "12-week general fitness programme for 58-year-old male post-MI (moderate-intensity, HR max ~115bpm)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Improve safe, moderate-intensity strength and cardio tolerance with gradual progression"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Intro Foundation":
        warmup:
          walking 7 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          leg_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5 minutes
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Light Mobility & Core":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          leg_extension 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 3 minutes
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Friday training 45m "Stability & Conditioning":
        warmup:
          walking 7 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_row 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          shoulder_press 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 3 minutes
  WEEK 2:
    DAY Monday training 45m "Progression A":
      warmup:
        walking 8 minutes
      main straight_sets:
        bench_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cable_row 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
      cooldown:
        shoulder_stretch 3 minutes
    DAY Wednesday training 45m "Stability & Core":
      warmup:
        walking 6 minutes
      main straight_sets:
        incline_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        lat_pulldown 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        plank 3x20s rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
      cooldown:
        chest_stretch 3 minutes
    DAY Friday training 45m "Active Recovery Focus":
      warmup:
        walking 6 minutes
      main straight_sets:
        dumbbell_row 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        lateral_raise 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        leg_extension 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
      cooldown:
        full_body_stretch 5 minutes
  WEEK 3:
    DAY Monday training 45m "Load accommodation A":
      warmup:
        walking 8 minutes
      main straight_sets:
        bench_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cable_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
      cooldown:
        light chest and back stretch 4 minutes
    DAY Wednesday training 45m "Mobility & Core Stability":
      warmup:
        walking 6 minutes
      main straight_sets:
        incline_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        dead_bug 3x8 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
      cooldown:
        hip_flexor_stretch 3 minutes
    DAY Friday training 45m "Endurance-lite":
      warmup:
        walking 8 minutes
      main straight_sets:
        leg_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        leg_curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        calf_raise 3x15 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
      cooldown:
        calf_stretch 3 minutes
  WEEK 4:
    DAY Monday training 45m "Phase 1 Finish - Consolidate":
      warmup:
        walking 8 minutes
      main straight_sets:
        bench_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cable_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
      cooldown:
        full_body_stretch 5 minutes
    DAY Wednesday training 45m "Light Cardio & Mobility":
      warmup:
        walking 6 minutes
      main straight_sets:
        lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        dumbbell_row 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        bird_dog 3x8 per side rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
      cooldown:
        back_stretch 3 minutes
    DAY Friday training 45m "Recovery Emphasis":
      warmup:
        walking 6 minutes
      main straight_sets:
        leg_extension 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        hip_thrust 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        glute_bridge 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
      cooldown:
        yoga_style_wind_down 5 minutes

PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
  WEEK 5:
    DAY Monday training 50m "Progressive Load Phase 2A":
      warmup:
        walking 8 minutes
      main straight_sets:
        bench_press 4x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cable_row 4x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
      cooldown:
        chest_back_combo_stretch 5 minutes
    DAY Wednesday training 50m "Tempo & Core":
      warmup:
        walking 6 minutes
      main straight_sets:
        incline_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        plank 3x25s rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
      cooldown:
        abdominal_stretch 3 minutes
    DAY Friday training 50m "Conditioning-lite":
      warmup:
        walking 8 minutes
      main straight_sets:
        leg_press 4x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        leg_curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        calf_raise 3x15 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
      cooldown:
        calf_stretch 3 minutes
  WEEK 6:
    DAY Monday training 50m "Load progression B":
      warmup:
        walking 8 minutes
      main straight_sets:
        bench_press 4x6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cable_row 4x8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        goblet_squat 4x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
      cooldown:
        upper_back_stretch 4 minutes
    DAY Wednesday training 50m "Mobility & Posture":
      warmup:
        walking 6 minutes
      main straight_sets:
        dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        shoulder_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        hip_thrust 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
      cooldown:
        shoulder_stretch 3 minutes
    DAY Friday training 50m "Active Recovery & Core":
      warmup:
        walking 6 minutes
      main straight_sets:
        leg_extension 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        side_plank 3x20s per side rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
      cooldown:
        full_body_stretch 5 minutes
  WEEK 7:
    DAY Monday training 50m "Phase 2 - Build Capacity":
      warmup:
        walking 8 minutes
      main straight_sets:
        bench_press 4x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        lat_pulldown 4x8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        goblet_squat 4x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
      cooldown:
        chest_back_combo_stretch 4 minutes
    DAY Wednesday training 50m "Stability & Core":
      warmup:
        walking 6 minutes
      main straight_sets:
        incline_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cable_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        dead_bug 3x10 per side rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
      cooldown:
        back_stretch 3 minutes
    DAY Friday training 50m "Conditioning-lite Plus":
      warmup:
        walking 8 minutes
      main straight_sets:
        leg_press 4x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        leg_curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        calf_raise 3x15 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
      cooldown:
        calf_stretch 3 minutes
  WEEK 8:
    DAY Monday training 50m "Phase 2 Finish - Consolidation":
      warmup:
        walking 8 minutes
      main straight_sets:
        bench_press 4x6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cable_row 4x8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        goblet_squat 4x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
      cooldown:
        upper_back_stretch 4 minutes
    DAY Wednesday training 50m "Mobility & Recovery Focus":
      warmup:
        walking 6 minutes
      main straight_sets:
        lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        bird_dog 3x8 per side rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
      cooldown:
        hip_flexor_stretch 3 minutes
    DAY Friday training 50m "Light Cardio & Core":
      warmup:
        walking 6 minutes
      main straight_sets:
        leg_extension 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        side_plank 3x20s per side rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
      cooldown:
        full_body_stretch 5 minutes

END
